development-theories-rostow.alt: A staircase of five steps rising from left to right: 1 traditional society, 2 preconditions for take-off, 3 take-off, 4 drive to maturity, 5 high mass consumption. An arrow labeled one path, step by step, climbs beside it.

development-theories-world-system.alt: Three stacked boxes. Core at the top: high-wage, high-tech and decision work. Semiperiphery in the middle: factories, some research and farming. Periphery at the bottom: raw materials and low-wage work. An arrow on the left carries raw goods and cheap labor up toward the core; an arrow on the right carries goods, loans and profits down from the core.
